GEOMETRY FIRST: exactly 1672 x 941 RGB canvas. Main walkable floor diamond (185,476),(835,151),(1485,476),(835,801). NE apron is a coplanar rectangle (1055,261),(1205,186),(1473,320),(1323,395); its outer edge (1205,186)-(1473,320) is diagonal, parallel to its doorway width, not vertical. Keep these extents well inside the canvas: at least 8% from borders. All opposing diamond edges are parallel at 26.6 degrees. One NE opening only. A broad 1300 x 650 open neutral deck.
Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new finished opaque RGB room plate S10_R01, R01_DESCENT. Image 1 is only fixed camera, scale, neutral standard deck, minimum floor size and doorway dimensions. Image 2 is only premium hard-surface material quality; ignore its actors, markings and UI.
Premium 2.5D tactical sci-fi game environment plate for SABLE CIRCUIT, underground research facility SITE-7.
CAMERA: fixed near-orthographic three-quarter top-down dimetric view. Floor panel seams and wall bases run at exactly a 2:1 slope (26.6 degrees from horizontal) in both diagonal directions. No perspective convergence, no fisheye, no tilted horizon.
SCALE: a standing adult would be about 1/12 of the image width tall. Square floor panels about one adult-height wide; waist-high railings; door frames about 1.6 adult-heights tall.
FLOOR: one clean, open, flat SITE-7 standard deck of dark gunmetal steel plates with fine seams and light wear, bounded by a wall base or a low raised lip. The floor is uncluttered: no text, no markings with letters or numbers, no objects in the open floor.
LIGHT: even neutral-white overhead industrial light (about 6000K) across the entire walkable floor. No hot spots, no pitch-black patches, no vignette, no darkened corners, no fog or haze over the floor. The floor stays neutral grey steel and is never tinted by room colour.
COLOUR IDENTITY: only on walls, machinery, fixtures and small practical lamps along the perimeter; their light spill on the floor is subtle and never reaches within one adult-height of a doorway.
OUTSIDE: everything beyond the architecture is flat near-black void (#07090D) with no gradient.
EXCLUDE: characters, creatures, robots, weapons, UI, HUD, text, signage, numbers, logos, projectiles, explosions, smoke over the floor, translucent or doubled geometry, black borders or frames.
STYLE: premium stylized realism with hard-surface wall thickness, recessed panels, structural supports and cast contact shadows. Not low-poly, not flat vector, not generic neon cyberpunk, not blurry concept art.
ROOM PLATE. The walkable floor is a dimetric diamond or elongated hexagon whose sides face NW (upper-left), NE (upper-right), SE (lower-right) and SW (lower-left). Back walls rise only along the NW and NE sides; the SW and SE sides end in a low lip or railing with no wall so nothing hides the floor. Keep the floor at least 8% away from every image border.
DOORS: open doorways exactly on these sides: NE. Each doorway is an unobstructed opening about 2.3 adult-heights wide with a heavy steel frame (a framed opening in a back wall, or a gap in the lip railing on the SW/SE side); no door leaf, no shutter. The same standard deck and the same neutral-white overhead light continue through every doorway for about 1.5 adult-heights on both sides of the threshold.
ROOM TYPE: non-combat room — walkable floor at least 850 x 450 (long x short, in the scale above).
IDENTITY: sealed descent shaft terminus: monolithic dark-alloy wall plating with a single glowing seam low on the wall and a heavy sealed hatch frame. Accent colour cold white, on walls and fixtures only.
Exactly 1 usable opening(s), only NE. All other sides (NW, SW, SE) are continuous closed walls or continuous low foreground railings: no rail gaps, floor tongues, passages, apparent doorway recesses or shutters there.
CRITICAL NEW WALL SILHOUETTE: redraw the wall architecture and machinery from the IDENTITY above; do not copy Image 1 wall masses, fans, consoles or machine arrangement. This room must differ from other operation-10 rooms and all earlier operation plates. Black alloy and red seams stay on the WALL architecture; include a few distinct small practical wall lamps in the required accent, with visible lamp cores and a restrained local wall glow. No lettering-like floor patterns, red light bloom, black floor or coloured floor. The floor is standard neutral gunmetal grey, mean sRGB luminance 0.17-0.24; doorway apron saturation at most 0.10. The exposed outside remains uniform #07090D.
Door apron outer edges are oblique and parallel to the attached deck; no vertical-cut pocket. All main floor AND apron tips must remain at least 8% inside each image border. Floor material and light are neutral, with no red wash or black alloy on the deck. Several clear perimeter lamp cores illuminate the wall only.
CRITICAL NEW WALL SILHOUETTE: two enormous uninterrupted offset black-alloy slabs, one long low horizontal reinforcing collar, and a single squared blind hatch FRAME on the closed NW wall with SOLID infill; it is not a door. Do not copy S3_R01 circular fans, pipes, turbine disks, repeated narrow mechanical wall bays, or its central corner support arrangement. Use smooth monolithic dark slabs with a few thick asymmetric buttresses, a thin white seam low on the wall and three cold-white practical lights. NE is the only framed OPEN doorway. Red hairlines only in wall joints; no red floor. Flat #07090D beyond all architecture.
ATTEMPT 2 - ARCHITECTURAL REBUILD: Image 1 has a repetitive thin-rib mechanical panel-wall layout. DO NOT repeat that layout, the thin rib columns, that central corner tower, or evenly spaced identical wall bays. Build a visibly different architectural MASSING: the CLOSED NW wall has one broad low rectangular sealed hatch frame spanning most of that wall, sunk into a continuous horizontal black slab, with flat solid infill. Above it one deep cantilevered rectangular lintel projects along the wall. The NE wall has only TWO very broad smooth staggered alloy slab masses on either side of its one open door, their heavy supports wide, blunt, and asymmetrically positioned. The meeting corner is a flat low bevel with NO tall corner pillar. Only three small cold-white lamp cores; the lit seam is confined to the wall base. No repeated narrow rib columns, grid of equal wall panels, fan bays, pipes, turbines, elaborate raised ramparts or tall central mast. The floor remains the same neutral grey diamond and NE apron geometry specified above, without any new opening. The low lip and continuous rails on SW and SE stay closed.
ATTEMPT 3 - FINAL CANVAS / CORNER REQUIREMENT: 1672x941, 16:9 landscape only. Closed NW wall: one long blunt sealed rectangular hatch housing filling its lower length, with a single broad asymmetric reinforcing collar. Open NE doorway: between two smooth flat monolithic dark-alloy masses. At the rear meeting corner there is simply a flat angled slab joint with low horizontal white seam; NO central tall illuminated pillar, NO equal repeating ribs. Keep the complete floor outline and apron inside the requested coordinates. NE apron end boundary must be DIAGONAL, never a vertical cut. Premium solid hard-surface geometry with no fans, pipes, turbines or circular mechanisms. All visible floor is standard evenly lit grey gunmetal with neutral door apron, NOT black alloy. Uniform #07090D outside.
